title: Uniform termwise annihilation implies doubled annihilation of an affine limit
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\mathcal I,\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves, $F,G\in\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $\alpha:F\to G$ a morphism. Let $t\geq1$ and assume $\mathcal K^t\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_{n+1})=\mathcal K^t\operatorname{Coker}(\alpha_{n+1})=0$ for every $n\in\mathbb N$, using kernels and cokernels of sheaves of modules. For every affine open $U\subseteq X$, let $\alpha_U:\varprojlim_n F_{n+1}(U)\to\varprojlim_n G_{n+1}(U)$ be the induced map [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-affine]. Then $\mathcal K(U)^{2t}$ annihilates both $\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_U)$ and $\operatorname{Coker}(\alpha_U)$.

theorem coherentFormalModule_annihilated_affine_limit
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F G : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ G) (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (α.hom.app (op n)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (α.hom.app (op n))))) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    K.ideal U ^ (2 * t) ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(X, U.1) (LinearMap.ker
      (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
        (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)))).hom) ∧
    K.ideal U ^ (2 * t) ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(X, U.1)
      (↥(limit (G.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) :
        ModuleCat Γ(X, U.1)) ⧸ LinearMap.range
        (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)))).hom)
